<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>North Coast Run Crew</title>
<meta name="description" content="North Coast Run Crew — social running on the North Coast.">
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;700;900&display=swap');

:root {
  --purple:#39219d;
  --purple-dark:#281574;
  --white:#fff;
  --black:#111;
  --yellow:#f4e83b;
  --max:1180px;
}
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }
body {
  margin:0;
  background:var(--purple);
  color:var(--white);
  font-family:"DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif;
}
a { color:inherit; }
.wrap { width:min(var(--max),calc(100% - 44px)); margin:auto; }

/* Header */
header {
  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:50;
  background:var(--purple);
  border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
}
.nav {
  min-height:82px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:25px;
}
.logo {
  width:82px;
  height:82px;
  display:block;
  background:var(--purple);
  object-fit:contain;
}
nav { display:flex; gap:30px; align-items:center; }
nav a {
  text-decoration:none;
  font-weight:900;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.03em;
  font-size:.82rem;
}
nav a:hover { opacity:.65; }
.nav-button {
  border:2px solid white;
  border-radius:999px;
  padding:10px 16px;
}

/* Hero */
.hero {
  min-height:calc(100vh - 82px);
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  position:relative;
}
.hero::before {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:42vw;
  height:42vw;
  max-width:650px;
  max-height:650px;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  border-radius:50%;
  right:-15vw;
  top:8%;
}
.hero-inner {
  width:100%;
  padding:75px 0 95px;
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
}
.hero-logo {
  width:min(235px,55vw);
  height:auto;
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:38px;
}
.kicker {
  font-weight:900;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.16em;
  font-size:.78rem;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
h1,h2,h3 {
  font-family:"Archivo Black",Impact,sans-serif;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  line-height:.9;
  letter-spacing:-.055em;
  margin:0;
}
h1 {
  font-size:clamp(4rem,11vw,9.5rem);
  max-width:1050px;
}
.hero-copy {
  max-width:630px;
  font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2vw,1.35rem);
  line-height:1.45;
  margin:30px 0 0;
}
.actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; margin-top:30px; }
.button {
  display:inline-block;
  padding:15px 22px;
  background:var(--white);
  color:var(--purple);
  border:2px solid var(--white);
  border-radius:0;
  text-decoration:none;
  font-weight:900;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.03em;
}
.button.dark {
  background:transparent;
  color:white;
}

/* Sections */
section { padding:100px 0; }
.white-section {
  background:white;
  color:var(--purple);
}
.section-title {
  font-size:clamp(3rem,7vw,6.5rem);
  max-width:900px;
}
.intro-grid {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:70px;
  align-items:end;
}
.large-copy {
  font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2.5vw,2rem);
  line-height:1.3;
  font-weight:700;
}
.cards {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:2px;
  margin-top:70px;
  background:var(--purple);
}
.card {
  padding:34px 30px 40px;
  background:white;
}
.card h3 {
  font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.7rem);
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.card p { font-size:1rem; line-height:1.55; color:#453b68; }

/* Run section */
.run {
  background:var(--yellow);
  color:var(--purple-dark);
}
.run-grid {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;
  gap:70px;
}
.run h2 { color:var(--purple-dark); }
.details { margin-top:45px; border-top:3px solid var(--purple-dark); }
.detail {
  padding:20px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(40,21,116,.35);
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:30px;
  font-weight:700;
}
.detail strong { text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; font-size:.75rem; }
.detail span { text-align:right; }

/* CTA */
.cta {
  background:var(--purple-dark);
  color:white;
  padding:75px 0;
}
.cta-grid {
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr auto;
  gap:50px;
  align-items:end;
}
.cta h2 { font-size:clamp(3.3rem,8vw,7rem); }
.cta p { max-width:650px; font-size:1.15rem; line-height:1.5; }

/* Footer */
footer {
  padding:30px 0;
  background:var(--purple-dark);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
}
.footer {
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:20px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  font-size:.78rem;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  font-weight:700;
}

/* Mobile */
@media(max-width:800px) {
  .nav { min-height:70px; }
  .logo { width:70px;height:70px; }
  nav a:not(.nav-button) { display:none; }
  .hero { min-height:auto; }
  .hero-inner { padding:55px 0 80px; }
  .hero-logo { width:180px; margin-bottom:30px; }
  .intro-grid,.run-grid,.cta-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:35px; }
  .cards { grid-template-columns:1fr; margin-top:45px; }
  .card { padding:28px; }
  section { padding:70px 0; }
  .detail { display:block; }
  .detail span { display:block; text-align:left; margin-top:5px; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="wrap nav">
    <a href="#" aria-label="North Coast Run Crew home">
      <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="North Coast Run Crew">
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Main navigation">
      <a href="#about">About</a>
      <a href="#run">The Run</a>
      <a href="#join">Join</a>
      <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
      <a class="nav-button" href="https://www.instagram.com/northcoastruncrew/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Instagram</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="wrap hero-inner">
      <img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="North Coast Run Crew logo">
      <div class="kicker">Portrush · Northern Ireland</div>
      <h1>Run the<br>North Coast.</h1>
      <p class="hero-copy">A friendly social 5k for every pace. No sign-ups. No pressure. Just show up, run together and enjoy the North Coast.</p>
      <div class="actions">
        <a class="button" href="#run">When &amp; where</a>
        <a class="button dark" href="https://www.instagram.com/northcoastruncrew/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Follow us</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="white-section" id="about">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="intro-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="kicker">NCRC</div>
          <h2 class="section-title">Run together.</h2>
        </div>
        <p class="large-copy">North Coast Run Crew is a social running crew based in Portrush. We meet every Thursday evening for an easy, inclusive 5k.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="cards">
        <article class="card">
          <h3>All<br>paces.</h3>
          <p>New runner or seasoned regular, everyone is welcome. Run at your own pace and take the halfway rest with the crew.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="card">
          <h3>No<br>pressure.</h3>
          <p>No membership. No fees. No commitment. Turn up when you can, bring a mate, and make Thursday your run night.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="card">
          <h3>Good<br>craic.</h3>
          <p>Meet by the sea, get the miles in and finish the evening with a proper North Coast community vibe.</p>
        </article>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="run" id="run">
    <div class="wrap run-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">Every Thursday</div>
        <h2 class="section-title">5k.<br>Your pace.</h2>
        <p class="large-copy">Meet at Babushka in Portrush, then head out together at 7:45pm.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="details">
        <div class="detail"><strong>Meet</strong><span>7:30pm</span></div>
        <div class="detail"><strong>Run</strong><span>7:45pm</span></div>
        <div class="detail"><strong>Distance</strong><span>5k + halfway rest</span></div>
        <div class="detail"><strong>Location</strong><span>Babushka, South Pier</span></div>
        <div class="detail"><strong>Pace</strong><span>All abilities</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="cta" id="join">
    <div class="wrap cta-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">Come along</div>
        <h2>Just show<br>up.</h2>
        <p>There’s no sign-up and no membership. Follow the crew on Instagram for weekly updates, then come and run with us.</p>
      </div>
      <a class="button" href="https://www.instagram.com/northcoastruncrew/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Instagram →</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="white-section" id="contact">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="intro-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="kicker">Find us</div>
          <h2 class="section-title">See you<br>Thursday.</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="large-copy">
          <p>Babushka Kitchen Café<br>South Pier, Portrush</p>
          <p>Every Thursday<br>Meet 7:30pm · Run 7:45pm</p>
          <p><a href="https://www.instagram.com/northcoastruncrew/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">@northcoastruncrew</a></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap footer">
    <span>NCRC — North Coast Run Crew</span>
    <span>Portrush · Northern Ireland</span>
  </div>
</footer>

</body>
</html>
